what: [deploy hygiene, low] Two noise lines on every git-sync deploy of the live VM, MEASURED 2026-10-03T10:21Z (diag journalctl?unit=ict-git-sync.service): (1) `scripts/install_systemd_units.sh: line 75: /etc/ict-vm-role: No such file or directory` -- the `2>/dev/null` on that line guards `tr`, not the shell's input redirect, so the missing role file prints an error on every unit refresh and _VM_ROLE_EARLY silently reads empty; (2) git on the VM clone warns `The last gc run reported ... remove .git/gc.log` / `too many unreachable loose objects; run git prune` on every fetch -- auto-gc is disabled until the file is removed, so the clone's object store only grows (disk 39.6% free today, so not urgent). Fix: redirect the role read as `$(cat /etc/ict-vm-role 2>/dev/null | tr -d ...)` or test -r first; add a `git prune && rm -f .git/gc.log` step (or a system-action) once. || BASIS for the disk figure (claim-basis guard, 2026-10-04): 39.6% free = 17.8 GB free of 45.0 GB on / (health snapshot 2026-10-04T07:58:10Z, check `disk`, ctx free_gb 17.83 / free_pct 39.65; n=1 snapshot, the latest at review time).
